events.title: Learn GitHub & Make Your First Contribution
events.text: Introduction to GitHub, repositories, commits, issues, pull requests — and your first contribution.

recap.text:
The event was all about Git and GitHub. We talked about how GitHub is important in the developer community and how much impact it has on people. Apart from that, we differentiated between Git and GitHub.

We did a completely hands-on session where we initialized Git by setting up email and usernames, created a repository, cloned it, added some demo files, committed them, and pushed them.

Later on, we spoke about what is happening in the GitHub developer community, like how many people are joining every second. We looked back at Octoverse and went over current trends, such as how TypeScript recently overtook Python, and all those related topics.

After that, we had a quiz on the session with a lot of good answers and participants, followed by goodies for the top three winners. That is basically all that happened.
